title: Understand the changes in your coffee leaves.
introduction: A photo, a few answers, and a useful record for a local agricultural officer. Crop Health Assistant provides initial screening, not a confirmed diagnosis.
availabilityTitle: Photo screening is not available yet
availabilityText: We are building the screening journey. Photos, AI results and report downloads will be added next.

journey.title: Add leaf photos
journey.description: Take a clear photo of one affected coffee leaf in natural light.

journey.title: Share what you noticed
journey.description: Answer a few short questions. You can choose Not sure.

journey.title: Read the observations
journey.description: See visible symptoms, uncertainty and guidance suitable for your region, when available.

journey.title: Prepare a report
journey.description: Download a record to share with a local agricultural officer yourself.

uncertaintyText: A photo cannot confirm a disease or show that a plant is healthy.
regionalText: Guidance reviewed for PNG will not be assumed suitable everywhere. When local guidance is missing, we will explain that and suggest a local agricultural officer.
sessionTitle: One check in the open tab
sessionText: The planned screening needs an internet connection. Refreshing or closing the tab will clear your assessment. Only language preference is remembered on your device.
translationNotice: Tok Pisin text is a draft and has not been reviewed by a fluent speaker.
footer: Coffee is the only planned MVP crop. PNG users are the first validation group; validation is still pending.
screeningStatement: Initial screening, not a confirmed diagnosis.
